QUESTION:
What are the most common adverse reactions to Lisinopril?

RESPONSE:
The provided label excerpt does not list a specific set of “most common” adverse reactions for lisinopril. It states that side effects of lisinopril are generally rare and apparently independent of dose. The excerpt does note these safety points: • Angioedema occurs (and has a higher reported incidence in Black patients). • Captopril (another ACE inhibitor) has caused agranulocytosis in some patients with renal impairment or collagen vascular disease, and available data are insufficient to exclude a similar risk with lisinopril. • When combined with hydrochlorothiazide, lisinopril tends to blunt the hypokalemia caused by the thiazide. For a complete list of common and less common adverse reactions, please refer to the full prescribing information’s ADVERSE REACTIONS section or consult your clinician or pharmacist.
